Question: Mary chose an even \(4\)-digit number \(n.\) She wrote down all the divisors of \(n\) in increasing order from left to right: \(1,\) \(2,\) \(\ldots,\) \(\tfrac{n}{2},\) \(n.\) At some moment Mary wrote \(323\) as a divisor of \(n.\) What is the smallest possible value of the next divisor written to the right of \(323?\)
